name: io.github.ty-meador/civ-v-llm-harness
title: Civilization V Harness (Linux)
description: Play Sid Meier's Civilization V (native Linux) as a human seat, by the game's own rules.

packageArguments.name: --seat
packageArguments.description: The player id this server plays, or 'auto' for the local player. In a hotseat game give each agent its own seat number.

environmentVariables.name: CIV5_TUNERD_SOCK
environmentVariables.description: Path of the Unix socket of the running tuner daemon (python -m harness.tunerd), usually $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/civ5-tuner.sock. The game and the daemon must be running first; see the install guide.

environmentVariables.name: CIV5_TUNERD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: This agent's seat token, when the daemon runs with a seat table (--seats). Not needed for a solo game.

environmentVariables.name: CIV5_CALL_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Optional path of a JSON-lines file that receives one line per tool call. Off when unset.
